pins.name: 3V3
pins.notes: Needs 3.3 V. Pin order may differ by board revision: check the silkscreen

pins.name: OT1
pins.notes: UART TX of the radar. Connect to an ESP32 RX pin (115200 or 256000 baud, depends on firmware)

pins.name: RX
pins.notes: UART: the part receives data here. Connect to an ESP32 TX pin

pins.name: OT2
pins.notes: HIGH when a person is present (3.3 V)

sources.title: Hi-Link HLK-LD2420 user manual
sources.section: Supply 3.3 V; pins 3V3, GND, OT1 (UART TX), RX, OT2 (presence output)
